summary.headline: Virgo-Born Male and Female Prognostications
summary.text: Astrological prognostications for a man and a girl born under Virgo, describing appearance, character, relationships, illnesses, vulnerable body parts, critical ages, lifespan, and healing rites to the Theotokos and Saint Anastasia the Pharmakolyt ria.
